summary: Q1 revise-propose resolved Q1-RP-004 and Q1-RP-005. The generation-aware Requirement now starts with an explicit Reader MUST statement and passes OpenSpec 1.7.0 Change strict validation. Initial explore/propose generations now use a Core-owned complete expected produced set rather than caller-optional tags: initial explore binds explore.md; initial propose binds proposal.md, design.md, tasks.md and every actual specs/** file. Initial completion, Reader and review entry share the same completeness contract and reject empty/partial sets or later-added unbound spec files. Revise-* keeps the previously accepted non-empty changed-tag subset overlay and inherited-ref validation. No production code, tests, Full Test, commit or push was performed.

resolvedFindings.evidence: The affected C1 delta Requirement body now begins with `Reader MUST ... generation-aware validation`. OpenSpec 1.7.0 CLI was actually executed against the revised Change and returned `Change 'execution-model-correction' is valid`.

The Proposal/design/delta/tasks now define a Core-owned complete initial expected set. Initial explore cannot omit explore.md. Initial propose cannot omit proposal/design/tasks or any actual specs/** file; review entry compares persisted refs with the current canonical namespace and rejects later-added unbound specs. Empty/partial initial-set negative fixtures and a complete initial-propose positive fixture are required. Revise successor subset overlay remains unchanged in principle.

preflight.fullReading: Read both 121 Blocking Findings and their requiredResolution. Q1-RP-004 is limited to parser-recognizable Requirement wording plus real CLI evidence. Q1-RP-005 requires complete initial-generation coverage across descriptor/derivation/preflight/effective-set/Reader-review/tests.
preflight.instanceEnumeration: Enumerated initial mutable generation entry points: initial explore and initial propose. Also checked revise-explore/revise-propose to avoid accidentally removing the accepted subset-overlay behavior.
preflight.implementability: The initial expected set is derivable entirely from Action + context.changeId + filesystem namespace: explore has one fixed file; propose has three fixed singleton files plus Core-enumerated specs/**. No new authority, snapshot store or Policy state is required.
preflight.consistency: Applied initial completeness to resolver semantics, terminal preflight, generation/effective-set construction, review entry/Reader and test tasks. Existing generation-aware supersession/archive rules remain intact.
